title: Singing a tune from the staff

cues.show: You at the mic, the tune on the staff on screen.
cues.say: This tool teaches you a short tune and shows you how close your voice is to each note.

cues.show: Tap a few notes on the staff.
cues.say: The tune is written on the staff. Tap a note to hear it by itself.

cues.show: Press the Play button and listen once without singing.
cues.say: Press the Play button below to hear the tune. The microphone starts with it.

cues.show: Press the Play button and listen once without singing.
cues.say: The first time, only listen, and follow the bar that runs over the notes.

cues.show: Press Play again and sing along on the note names. Point at your line.
cues.say: Now sing along on the note names.

cues.show: Press Play again and sing along on the note names. Point at your line.
cues.say: Your line shows where your voice is. On a note it sits on the note. If it is under the note, your voice is low. If it is over it, your voice is high.

cues.show: Press Play again and sing along on the note names. Point at your line.
cues.say: _Don't reach for high notes: sing only where your voice feels easy._

cues.show: Press Tune to mute the tune and sing over the chords. Then press Chords too.
cues.say: Sing along with the tune a few times. Then press Tune below to mute it, and sing over the chords alone.

cues.show: Press Tune to mute the tune and sing over the chords. Then press Chords too.
cues.say: Then press Chords to mute them as well, and sing it a cappella.

cues.show: Press Piano roll, then Staff. Sing it on "oo", then quietly, then hum it.
cues.say: Try things with it. Press Piano roll to see the tune as bars, and Staff to go back.

cues.show: Press Piano roll, then Staff. Sing it on "oo", then quietly, then hum it.
cues.say: Sing it on "oo", then on "la", then hum it.

cues.show: Press Piano roll, then Staff. Sing it on "oo", then quietly, then hum it.
cues.say: Sing it very quietly. Sing it short and bouncy, then smooth.

cues.show: Press Piano roll, then Staff. Sing it on "oo", then quietly, then hum it.
cues.say: The goal of this practice is to hum the whole tune before it plays.
